 Why People May Need LIHEAP 
 Posted By: Marcus Mackey 
 November 3, 2026 @ 5:30 am
 Today's Local News 
 Tweet 
 Share 
 Email 
 Individuals can still apply for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
 New Opportunities Outreach Supervisors Heidi Billmeier says that the application website for LIHEAP remains open for the time being. She tells Raccoon Valley Radio why people may need to apply for this assistance program.
 “We serve a lot of elderly and disabled. They initially could have applied in October and we’re still working through some of those applications. And sometimes you just have families who, even though they may have dual incomes in those homes, they’re just not making ends meet. And that’s where we come into play. Households up to 200 % of poverty are eligible to apply.”
 Billmeier mentions that how LIHEAP helps, is it provides a one-time payment to a person’s heating vendor, and protects them during winter months from having their heating source disconnected, whether it be gas or electric. She adds that the application window will close on April 30th, but that individuals can find the application on their website.
